trends.name: Iran War De-escalation & Hormuz Risk
trends.summary: Trump declared Iran conflict 'winding down' in primetime address with military objectives met, but 2,500 Marines deploying to region. Asia faces critical Strait of Hormuz dependency (45% of crude imports, 30% gasoline/naphtha) creating ongoing volatility in oil markets and energy costs despite ceasefire optimism. Uncertainty persists around actual resolution timeline.

trends.name: Oil Prices Easing, Risk Sentiment Rising
trends.summary: Oil prices declining amid de-escalation signals, lifting S&P 500 +0.7% and Nasdaq 100 +1.2% as risk appetite improves. Energy cost relief removing inflation pressure from consumer spending and corporate margins. Market volatility still driven by geopolitical uncertainty around Hormuz chokepoint.

trends.name: Tech Sector Correction & Rotation Trade
trends.summary: QQQ facing 2026 tech correction with JEPQ outperforming; small-cap rotation gaining traction through SCAP as investors shift away from mega-cap concentrated positions. Multiple tech earnings (Sunny Optical, Micron doubling down) indicate sector consolidation and repricing underway.

trends.name: DHS Funding Deal & Government Shutdown Risk
trends.summary: Senate and House Republicans agreed to advance two-track DHS funding plan that ditches voter ID provisions and leaves ICE partially unfunded, averting immediate TSA shutdown. Deal raises questions about TSA agent funding sources and ongoing budget uncertainty affecting travel/commerce sector.

trends.name: Recession Odds Collapse on Sentiment Shift
trends.summary: Market-implied recession probability plummeted to 26% from March highs, signaling improved risk outlook. However, real consumer spending contracted when adjusted for inflation with sluggish Q1 retail sales beneath headline numbers—suggesting recovery narrative may be overstated.

trends.name: Semiconductor Stock Strength & Intel Turnaround
trends.summary: Intel shares surged 9% on back of Ireland fab buyback signaling renewed manufacturing strength and turnaround momentum. Micron also rallying with analyst doubling down. Chip stocks added to Deutsche Bank tech picks, indicating sector rerating after 2025 weakness. Critical for tech infrastructure and AI narratives.

trends.name: Consumer Staples Holding Up Despite Inflation
trends.summary: Egg prices crashed 70% providing consumer relief narrative; Conagra and Calvin Klein parent easing investor anxieties about demand through marketing success (Love Story TV tie-in). Sam's Club membership fee hike to $60 signals pricing power in value channels. Mixed signals on real purchasing power.

trends.name: Banking Sector Valuation & Rate Environment
trends.summary: Analysts highlighting three paths to ignite beaten-down bank stocks (Wells Fargo, Goldman Sachs) amid whipsawing rates threatening spring home-buying season. Rate volatility creating both risk and opportunity in financials. Rithm Capital offering 10% yield attractive to income investors. Sector repricing on Fed policy expectations.

trends.name: Infrastructure & Commodities as Hedge Trade
trends.summary: Quanta Services positioned as infrastructure trade of the decade amid geopolitical tensions and energy crisis. Newmont (gold miner) catching falling knife as precious metals benefit from inflation/geopolitical hedging. TotalEnergies discussing decarbonization amid energy insecurity—indicating shift toward resilience-focused commodity investing.

trends.name: Trump Tariffs Economic Impact Assessment
trends.summary: $4/gallon gas prices hitting harder in 2026 than 2022 due to tariff-driven cost increases compounding inflation perception. 'Liberation day' tariff retrospective shows hidden costs to American economy. Consumer psychology on pricing deteriorating despite nominal income gains—key headwind for retail/discretionary spending.

trends.name: Crypto & Digital Asset Institutional Adoption
trends.summary: Franklin Templeton acquiring digital assets investment firm to expand active crypto management capabilities, signaling institutional legitimacy push. Crypto adoption accelerating among legacy financial firms seeking exposure to digital currency narrative. Institutional capital deployment increasing sector legitimacy.

trends.name: Artificial Intelligence Risk & Claude Code Leak
trends.summary: Anthropic executive blamed Claude AI code leak on process errors, raising enterprise AI security and IP protection concerns. Incident highlights operational risks in AI deployment as corporations accelerate implementation. May prompt cautious investor stance on AI-dependent business models and cybersecurity spending needs.
